human_tolerance.notes: Human development and water pollution degrade habitat. Avoider is a modelling judgement.

taxonomy.note: Accepted species rank and authority verified at the GBIF provider; iNaturalist independently confirms an active species-rank taxon.

external.note: GBIF API and iNaturalist API independently resolved Lontra canadensis at accepted/active species rank on 2026-11-01; Wikidata Q327028 cross-links the same identifiers (P846 and P3151).

traits.lifespan_y.note: Midpoint of ADW’s typical wild lifespan interval of 8-9 years, stored as 8.5; this is not a reported average. ADW lists 21 years separately as a captivity maximum, which is not used.

traits.wariness.note: Judgement from NPS discussion of disturbance and habitat degradation; numerical value is an authored model parameter.

traits.mass_kg.note: Midpoint of the NPS 10-30 lb interval, converted to kg. This is an interval midpoint, not a reported population mean.

traits.length_m.note: Midpoint of the NPS 40-54 inch length interval, converted to 1.016-1.372 m.

traits.diet.note: Judgement translating qualitative evidence that aquatic prey dominate, especially fish and crustaceans, into normalized proportions.

traits.social.note: Mostly solitary with females and offspring associating; group-size interval is an authored simplification.

traits.activity_pattern.note: NPS describes river otters as mostly crepuscular but seen at all times of day.

traits.defense.note: ADW says vigilance and agility in water and on land help them escape predators.

habitat.use.note: Judgement expressing the NPS description of the species as equally at home on land and water; shares are model weights, not measured time budgets.

habitat.requires.note: Near-water placement follows NPS habitat description; 500 m distance is an authored placement threshold.

habitat.resources.note: Resource weights are authored judgements. The schema has no fish-specific tag, so fish/amphibians use small_vertebrate and crayfish/crabs use invertebrate.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Avoider is a modelling judgement based on documented threats from settlement, recreation, and habitat degradation.

seasonal.note: NPS reports year-round activity and late-March/April breeding in Yellowstone; the phase dates are an authored month-day approximation scoped to Montana, not all US populations.

behavior.note: Local FSM supports swim/walk movement and aquatic prey actions; it favors hunting in civil twilight, allows feeding at any hour when very hungry, rests on high energy need, and flees threats. Distance, need thresholds and twilight angles are authored controls. Small_vertebrate and invertebrate are the schema food tags.

look.note: Dark brown palette follows NPS description; block proportions and animation tuning are judgement.

range.note: NPS states the species is native to South Dakota and Nebraska and occurs throughout North America; this record is scoped to the requested US country range.
